newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-RELAXED JUVENTUS SINK TURKEY'S FENERBAHCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RELAXED JUVENTUS SINK TURKEY'S FENERBAHCE.

text.p: A solitary goal from Alen Boksic in the 21st minute gave Italy's Juventus victory over Fenerbahce of Turkey in a scrappy European Cup Champions' League Group C match on Wednesday.

Fenerbahce, playing nervously and making simple errors against the reigning European champions, lost possession in the penalty area, allowing Croatian striker Boksic to swoop and fire the ball into the back of the net.
The Istanbul team had the first serious attempt on goal when Bosnian forward Elvir Bolic's header in the 10th minute from an angled pass by Tarik Dasgun just skimmed over the bar.

Bolic had another chance in the 30th minute but collided with Juventus goalkeeper Michelangelo Rampulla and shot wide. Both sides squandered several chances in the second half but a relaxed Juventus, taking their second victory in two Group C games, were able to keep the upper hand.
